approved_by: user, 2026-10-08, before any short-side or put result was examined
context: All earlier V8 tests were long-only. H1 (SUE earnings drift) long was confirmed on the 2026 holdout (docs/specs/V8_H1_CONFIRM_PREREG_20261008.json). This tests its mirror. The 2026 holdout has been used once (long side); the short leg trades different events, so it can still confirm, but the period is no longer untouched.

strategies.H1_short: exact mirror of H1b_sue_h20: SUE in the bottom tercile of the prior 365 days (>= 30 events); short at the next 10:30 ET bar; cover 20 bars after the latest signal; 10 slots, adv20 priority, admission panel, forced covers; nn_meta.v8_engine.simulate_short
strategies.H1_long_short: the H1 long book (H1b_sue_h20) and the H1 short book with equal capital, rebalanced daily (daily return = mean of the two books' returns)
strategies.H1_puts: mirror of the calls test B: one put per short signal, ~45 DTE (35-60), strike nearest delta -0.60, same exits, fixed 6% spread (half 3%, stress 4.5%), $0.05/contract, 5% of equity premium, <= 10 open

short_costs.spread_and_fees: nn_meta.v8_fills: entry pays the sell cost (half-spread x name factor + slippage + sell fees), cover pays the buy cost; cost multiplier 1.0 and 1.5
short_costs.borrow: annual 1% when the prior close >= $20 and adv20 >= $250M, else 5%; accrued every day on the short's current value. Availability assumed (flatters hard-to-borrow names).

H1_short.alpha: intercept of daily OLS on the equal-weight admitted universe > 0 (annualized)
H1_short.deflated_sharpe: >= 0.95 over 2023-2025 daily returns, N = 18 (16 event variants + 2 here)

dev_pass_all_required.H1_puts: same as calls: total > 0, >= 4/6 folds positive, mean trade > 0 with t >= 2, and total/mean/t at half-spread 4.5%

holdout_2026.H1_long_short: Sharpe > QQQ's and alpha > 0 at 1.0x and 1.5x
holdout_2026.H1_puts: total > 0 and mean trade > 0 with t >= 1 at half-spread 3%

single_run: one run, reported whatever the outcome
